wire.headline: Highland Cream Collective Reveals Major Restructuring Plan Amid Rising Costs
sentences: The board of Highland Cream Collective voted unanimously on 4 November to proceed with the company's strategic changes.
The dairy firm announced a 310m GBP restructuring plan to address ongoing financial pressures.
Company officials cited rising 4,800 tonne raw milk costs as a primary driver for the necessary operational adjustments.
CEO Marian Holt confirmed that the plan includes a target for a 12% workforce reduction.
The closure of the Deeside processing plant is scheduled to take place in March 2027.
Shares in the company dropped 4.8% during post-announcement trading following the release of the details.
Analyst James Rook predicts that the restructuring will result in a 12.4p per share dilution for investors.
